steps.title: Book your appointment
steps.short: Reserve a private consultation online or on WhatsApp, ideally before you fly.
steps.long: Every order starts with a booked consultation, so Thinh or Thuong Phan can set the time aside for you alone. Book on the calendar or message us on WhatsApp, ideally before you arrive in Ho Chi Minh City.

steps.title: Consultation and measurement
steps.short: Choose the cloth with the founders. We take over 20 measurements and draft your pattern.
steps.long: At the villa you talk through the occasion, how you like to wear a suit and the details you want. You choose the cloth together, then we take over 20 measurements and draft a pattern for your build.

steps.title: First fitting
steps.short: Try the garment close to finished, and every line is adjusted before the rest of the order is made.
steps.long: Your first garment comes back close to finished. You try it on and move in it while we adjust the shoulders, length, waist and sleeves. This fitting confirms the fit before the rest of a multi-piece order is completed.

steps.title: Finishing and handover
steps.short: Final adjustments, then a professional clean and press, ready to wear.
steps.long: After the fitting, the garment gets its final adjustments and is professionally dry-cleaned to clean and set its shape. It is handed over ready to wear, or packed for your flight.

steps.title: Alterations for life
steps.short: Your pattern stays on file, and alterations on anything we make are free for life.
steps.long: We keep your pattern and measurements on file. If your build changes, bring the garment back: alterations on everything we make are free for life.

about.title: Two architects who became tailors
about.sub: Phan's Custom Tailor is run by Thinh and Thuong Phan, who still measure, cut and fit for every client.
body: Thinh and Thuong Phan graduated from the Ho Chi Minh City University of Architecture in 2003. They came back to the family trade with a different way of looking at a suit: as a structure built around one person.

That training still shapes the work. Proportion decides where a button sits and how long a jacket runs. Balance decides how a shoulder carries the cloth. Each cut is planned for the wearer's build, so the garment sits cleanly when you move, not only when you stand still.
Phan's has made clothes in Ho Chi Minh City since 2013, and today works from a private villa in Saigon Pearl, where consultations and fittings happen away from a busy shop floor.

faq.kicker: Getting a suit made in Vietnam
faq.title: Questions before your first fitting
faq.sub: Short answers on time, prices, cloth and visiting the villa. If yours isn't here, message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: What's the difference between bespoke and ready-to-wear?
items.a: Ready-to-wear is made in standard sizes. A bespoke garment starts from a pattern drafted for your measurements and build, then is adjusted over fittings until it fits.

items.q: How long does it take to make a suit in Vietnam with Phan's?
items.a: Five working days as standard, including the fittings. Rush orders are possible; we discuss timing at your consultation.
Cloth from Vitale Barberis Canonico in Italy and Holland & Sherry in England, our own Nobility range, and wool, cotton, linen and cashmere from European and South Korean suppliers.
Yes. We make suits, trousers and skirts for women, cut to measure with the same fittings and lifetime alterations.

items.q: How much does a tailored suit cost?
items.a: From 6,800,000 VND for a 2-piece suit and 8,400,000 VND for a 3-piece. Dress trousers start at 2,200,000 VND and shirts at 1,300,000 VND. Every price includes lifetime free alterations.
Yes, free for life on everything we make, even if your measurements change.

items.q: Do I need a tailor appointment in Saigon?
items.a: We recommend it, so the founders can give you their full attention. Book on our calendar or message us on WhatsApp.

items.q: Can I come on a Sunday or a public holiday?
items.a: By prior appointment only. We close for about two weeks over Tết, the Lunar New Year, so message us first if you are visiting in late January or February.

items.q: Where are you, and is there parking?
items.a: At a villa on D9 Street in Saigon Pearl, Bình Thạnh. There is parking for cars and motorbikes in front of the villa.

items.q: Can I reorder after I leave Vietnam?
items.a: We keep your pattern and measurements on file.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.welcomeSub: Please read this before you book, so everything goes smoothly at the villa.

items: Extreme rush (under 72 hours): strictly subject to workshop capacity. An 8% expedited production fee applies to orders needed within 48 hours (standard season) or 72 hours (peak season).
Flight deadlines: if you leave within 4 days, reply to your confirmation email straight away with your flight details. Rush orders are not guaranteed without that email.
Punctuality: each appointment has a 30-minute grace period. After that, without notice on WhatsApp or email, walk-in clients may be served first.
Shared space: the studio serves several clients at the same time.
Fabric availability and pricing are re-confirmed 30 days before you arrive.
A 3% courtesy discount is offered for smooth cooperation. The 8% expedited fee, if it applies, is calculated separately.
Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM

consult: Standard session for 1–2 people. Fabric selection, styling and professional measurements. 45–60 minutes.
urgent: Extreme rush service. The 8% expedited fee applies automatically. Subject to workshop capacity.
group: Joint session for 2 or more men (groomsmen, friends). Tell us exactly which pieces you need.
female: 2-piece or 3-piece suits only, no dresses. Upload reference styles for the master tailor to review.
fitting: First or second fitting. We pin and adjust the details for the right proportions.
pickup: Your last fitting before you take your order home.
repair: Professional adjustments to jackets, trousers or shirts you already own.
